context: Enterprise Islamic Rural Banking (BPR Syariah) Performance Monitoring & Field AO Operations Dashboard
design_archetype: Islamic Banking Premium (Emerald Green, Champagne Gold, Pearl White, Slate Charcoal)
theme_strategy: Light mode default with dark-toned executive card options & high contrast readable mobile interface for field AOs

layout_and_spacing.dashboard_grid: grid grid-cols-1 md:grid-cols-3 lg:grid-cols-4 gap-4 sm:gap-6 p-4 sm:p-6 lg:p-8 max-w-7xl mx-auto
layout_and_spacing.mobile_optimization: Sticky bottom bar for quick field action input on mobile, expandable filter drawer, touch-friendly tap targets (minimum 44px height)
layout_and_spacing.kpi_card_padding: p-5 sm:p-6 rounded-2xl shadow-sm border border-slate-200/80 hover:shadow-md transition-all
layout_and_spacing.header_strategy: Sticky glassmorphism navigation with backdrop blur (backdrop-blur-md bg-white/90 dark:bg-slate-900/90), logo badge, quick role switcher, and period selector

key_views: Login Page with Islamic Banking Geometry & PT BPRS Haji Miskin Logo
Executive Dashboard (Bank-wide KPI, Target vs Realisasi, High-level Charts, Approval Requests)
Admin Control Panel (Transaction Entry Form, Target Setter, Incentive Calculator, User Management, Audit Trail)
AO Pembiayaan Dashboard (Realisasi Rp, Target %, NPF Ratio, Leaderboard Rank, Incentive Forecast)
AO Funding Dashboard (Pertumbuhan DPK, Tabungan, Deposito, Top Client Accounts)
Collection Activity Portal (Jadwal Kunjungan, Bukti Foto Lapangan Upload, Restrukturisasi Status)
Leaderboard / Peringkat AO (Filter Pembiayaan, Funding, Recovery with Badges)
Approval Center (Pending Incentive & User Permissions with Batch Approve/Reject)
Riwayat Bulanan (Monthly Trend Charts & Export Data capabilities)

component_guidelines.login_screen: Split screen layout with left emerald gold branding pattern & right clean login form (Kode Marketing + Password + Role Quick Preset selector for smooth testing).
component_guidelines.kpi_cards: Use bold Rupiah formatting (e.g., 'Rp 4.850.000.000'), target completion progress bar, indicator badge (+12% vs bulan lalu), and gold accent trim.
component_guidelines.tables: Shadcn-style data tables with sticky headers, search filter, period filter dropdown (Bulan & Tahun), status pills, and action dropdowns (Edit, Approve, Detail).
component_guidelines.charts: Recharts AreaChart for monthly trend with Emerald Green gradient fill and Gold line highlight; BarChart for target vs actual breakdown.
component_guidelines.photo_upload: Field collection documentation modal with drag & drop or image preview, geotag location tag, and notes field.
component_guidelines.toast: Use Sonner for confirmation messages (e.g. 'Transaksi pencapaian berhasil disimpan', 'Insentif telah disetujui').

testing_and_accessibility.data_testid_requirement: EVERY interactive element (buttons, tabs, inputs, selects, filter switches, export buttons, modal triggers) MUST include a kebab-case data-testid attribute.

instructions_to_main_agent: Build a complete, fully interactive enterprise web application in JavaScript React.
Ensure all user roles (Direktur, Admin, AO Pembiayaan, AO Funding, Collection) can be easily previewed using a prominent top-bar Role Switcher.
Ensure total visual delight with Emerald Green (#047857) dominance, Gold (#D97706) highlights, and clean modern card styling.
Implement real currency formatting in Indonesian Rupiah (Rp) and percentage calculations for targets.
Provide modal dialogs for transaction input, photo upload documentation for collection, and approval actions.
Make sure mobile viewport (< 768px) is fully usable with responsive tables, touchable buttons, and collapsible navigation.

UNIVERSAL GUIDELINES FOR MAIN AGENT.avoid_ai_slop: Do not create plain gray centered boxes. Use rich layered cards, emerald gradient subtle backdrops, and crisp gold accent lines.
UNIVERSAL GUIDELINES FOR MAIN AGENT.no_universal_transition: Never use transition: all. Use specific property transitions like transition-colors or transition-shadow.
UNIVERSAL GUIDELINES FOR MAIN AGENT.no_emoji_icons: Use Lucide React icons instead of emoji characters.
UNIVERSAL GUIDELINES FOR MAIN AGENT.data_testid: Must attach data-testid to all interactive components.
UNIVERSAL GUIDELINES FOR MAIN AGENT.react_js: This is a JavaScript project (.js/.jsx). Do not use TypeScript type annotations in code files.
